title: Feature List
description: Track feature implementation state for agent-driven development

dependencies.description: Feature IDs that must be done before this one

evidence.description: Verification evidence when status is 'done'. Keep to one line: a commit hash plus a short pointer (e.g. 'Commit abc1234 - added X, tests pass'). Debugging narrative, rejected alternatives, and design discussion belong in the commit message, not here — this field is an index into git history, not a changelog.
